title: August and the Harbor
author: Paloma Eriksen
blurb: Ansel Amberdale, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
